alphas-secret-bride:
Emma Greens was always the unwanted daughter—an adopted omega with no bloodline, no status, and no future.
When her perfect sister secretly marries her off to a mysterious Alpha, Emma expects cruelty… but instead she meets Brandon—powerful, dangerously handsome, and strangely obsessed with her.
Whispers in the pack claim he loves another woman, one hidden behind locked doors. Heartbroken, Emma prepares to leave… until she discovers the truth.
The Alpha’s secret obsession has always been her.
Now, with forbidden love, deadly rivalries, and a pack that will never accept her, Emma must fight for the man who has loved her in secret for eleven years—or risk losing him forever.
Every choice comes with danger, every glance carries secrets, and every heartbeat could be her last. Will Emma survive the pack’s deadly politics and claim the Alpha meant for her?
amaryllis-in-the-ice-country:
In the distant future, the world was in ice
Humans live in cryo facilities underground, awaiting for the distant Spring,
Robots manage the facilities

anthesis-of-sadness:
We follow Anthony, a man forced to adapt to a world of dark fantasy that imposes itself on him with an unmistakable brutality. A place where shadow and violence reign supreme, where inequality is riven and the laws of nature are distorted. A world where every moment could be the last.
What fate does this cruel universe hold for our protagonist? What hidden secrets do the powerful hide behind cold and inaccessible masks? And what alliances, betrayals or rivalries will be woven into this maelstrom of supernatural forces and unfathomable powers?
To survive, Anthony will have to fight, evolve and face his own demons. For in this place, no matter the greatness of the beings that populate it, it is tenacity that dictates the law.
big-life:
Death, Depression, Poverty, Love issues – all things that a 27-year-old no-name writer faces.
Yet, with one fateful day, one fateful supernatural event, he gains the powers of a dead genius writer. Everything changes after that, and success after success comes to him.
Yet, he has a rival in love and writing, one who is also a famous writer and son of an international publishing corporation. This rival will do anything he can with his influence to beat him into submission.
This is a story of a writer, who must succeed against all odds.
catastrophic-necromancer:

The game descends upon reality, world rules are overturned, and humanity enters an era of universal career change.
Magical beasts run rampant! Secret realms, dungeons, and abysses are countless!
Terror and treasures coexist! Danger and opportunity go hand in hand!
Only by becoming a career changer, leveling up, and growing stronger can one stand at the pinnacle of the world!

He gains a god-level passive skill, transferring all damage to his summons.

“Countless undead bone dragons!”
“Can you withstand it?”
Under the curse, even gods turn to bones.
Corpses explode, the sky falls and the earth shatters, the world collapses.
“I sit high upon the throne of bones, walking between life and death.”
“I am the calamity!”
celestial-emperor-of-devouring:
Gu Chenfeng was originally the Eternal Celestial Emperor of the Divine Realm. To break through the shackles of the Saint, he practiced the Nine Revolutions of Reincarnation, living through nine lives of reincarnation just to achieve the sanctification of the nine revolutions.
However, in the ninth life of reincarnation, Gu Chenfeng lost the memory of being the Celestial Emperor. He was expelled from his Sect for cutting off the arms of the Young Master of the Martial King's Mansion and crippled by the Martial King's Mansion's experts, who destroyed his Sea of Qi and broke his meridians.

“The humiliation of today, I will return tenfold in the future!”
chasing-and-claiming-my-rejected-omega-m:
Born an omega in a time where omegas are rare and unwanted, Rory lived a life whereby he was always a second option in every situation. Omegas couldn’t birth pups, so no one wanted to be mated to them, except to fuck them and move on.
He thought he was lucky to be betrothed to an alpha who loved him, but after a shocking betrayal, his heart turned to stone.
Fleeing for his life led him into the clutches of Jason, a dangerous, ruthless wolf. He loses his virginity to him and the morning after, he realized that this soulless Alpha is his fated mate. But, once again, Rory is reminded of his curse of always being a second option when he got rejected.
As if that wasn’t enough, he soon realized his life is in immense danger. Rory then decides to run away and start afresh in a different country.
One thing Rory didn’t expect to happen, was for him to end up pregnant weeks after fleeing!
~~~
Years later, Rory now has an adorable son. He wasn’t the timid omega he once was, because he had managed to rise to the very top. Along the line, he managed to open his heart up to Kenny, a cute Alpha who loved and cherished him wholeheartedly, leading him to live a contented life.…

But she heard that at the awards ceremony, Wei Shixu tore up his university admission letter.
A year later, a certain repeater pursued her to her university.

crown-of-hearts:
***Together, they were like fire and ice.***
Damon pursued, ready to conquer while Alexander ran, trying so hard to remain cold and guarded.

death-draw-system-infinite-revives-in-th:
I died three times before I realized the coffin wasn’t meant to kill me.
It was meant to break me.
My gold-digging girlfriend shoved me into a Silver-rank horror dungeon with 0 HP, hoping I’d die for good so she could steal my parents’ hidden fortune. Instead, I awakened a cursed system that rewards me every time I die.
One death. One card draw.
The more painful my death, the better the reward.
Now I’m farming ghosts for loot, bullying monsters that should terrify me, and accidentally traumatizing a ghost bride who just wanted a peaceful haunting career. Every dungeon hides secrets, every death makes me stronger, and somewhere inside this nightmare world is an SSS-rank class powerful enough to overturn fate itself.
The problem?
The ghosts have started recognizing me.
And they’re beginning to realize that the real monster in the dungeon… is me.
dimension-master: On just another normal school day, while 16-year-old Drake Wilson drives his two best friends, Mike and Chad, to school, an unexpected twist of fate occurs in the form of a cat. When a cat runs across the road, Drake narrowly misses it, and his car ends up driving into a nearby field. With a sudden storm, a flash of light explodes, creating a dimensional portal in front of them. There is nothing they could do to stop the car from entering the portal. On the other side, they find themselves in another dimension filled with magic and power. To Drake, the place looks familiar because it is the starting point of his new game called “Dimension Master.”
divine-god-against-the-heavens: Heavenly Pearl, an unknown mysterious, and heaven-defying object, for some reason, enter the heart of a young man named Ye Xiao who was framed and crippled by his fellow sect members for some unknown reasons and got kicked out from his sect. From then on, Ye Xiao embarks on the path of Martial Arts, cultivates to the peak of the summit, and ascends the heavens. With the help of Heavenly Pearl, he will fight against the gods and devils and even against the heavens. “No One Has The Right To Look Down On Me, Not Even The Heavens”.
dragon-system-red-dragon-legacy:
Orion had everything — a great family, an elite education, and a future already mapped out for him. The only problem? He was unbearably bored.
Trapped in a life of routine and expectations, Orion dreamed of adventure, freedom, and becoming the protagonist he only read about in books. He never expected fate to answer that wish in the most brutal way possible.
One careless step.
One speeding car.
And everything ended.
…or so he thought.
Instead of death, Orion awakens to the mysterious DRAGON System, a powerful force that chooses him as its host and drags him into a world where strength must be earned, monsters roam freely, and survival is never guaranteed.
Follow Orion’s journey as he claws his way to the top of this new world
earth-became-a-cultivation-world-when-i-:
Levi, a young man who spent over a thousand years in a cultivation world, awakens in a hospital only to discover that two years have passed on Earth. The world he left behind has completely changed—mysterious spiritual energy has appeared, transforming Earth into a cultivation world filled with monsters, undead cultivators, and mysterious places like floating islands.
Though Levi is furious that the entity who transported him to the other world failed to stop time on Earth as promised, he must now face the new reality. In a world now filled with cultivators, interdimensional conflicts, and the presence of a cultivation leveling system, Levi struggles to adjust to his weakened human body while seeking to uncover what happened to his mysteriously missing family.
eternal-emperors-path-to-ascension:
The Path to Immortality is elusive, and everyone wants to achieve it even if there's only a glimmer of hope.
Tian Yongheng is a person who regained his past life memories after his family was brutally slaughtered. His extreme fear of death and desire to be undying have forced him to step onto this dangerous path of Immortal Cultivation.
He is not a Chosen One who is the favored son of heavens, nor is he the reincarnation of a Great Emperor. Armed with a unique system of unknown origins and his obsession with immortality, he sets forth to carve a way of his own in this world where fate toys with one's very existence itself and cosmic horror-like beings devour universes for fun.
However, can he really touch the illusory, eternal and ethereal Immortal Dao that is everlasting and everchanging?
Will he ever be able to reach the end of this grand path to eternity, establishing himself as a myth and beyond? or will he also drown in the long river of history just like many others?
-------
The background settings and world building of this story are greatly inspired by Top Tier Providence, Secretly Cultivate for a Thousand Years.…

i-will-be-the-perfect-wife-this-time:
“I betrayed the only man who stayed faithful to me, and died by the hand of the father I worshipped.”
​Olivia Luceron was the perfect tool. For years, she acted as a spy within her own marriage, feeding her father secrets to dismantle her husband’s power. Her reward? A cold dungeon, a mutilated body, and a walk of shame through the empire’s streets.
​Her husband, Duke Matthias, whom she treated with nothing but icy indifference, died protecting her. Her father, whom she gave her soul to, was the one who ordered her torture.
​Now, Olivia has returned a year before her death.
​The platinum hair she lost is back. The scars on her chest have vanished. And Matthias—the man who kissed her forehead in a dark cell before facing the executioner—is still alive.
​She doesn't seek his forgiveness. She doesn't even seek his love. In this life, Olivia has only one goal: to use her position as the Duchess to systematically destroy the Locron family from within.
​She will be the “Perfect Wife” this time—a mask of ice to hide a heart of fire.
“Dear Father, you taught me how to be a monster. It’s only fair that I show you what I’ve learned.”
idle-mage-humanitys-strongest-backer:

You play the game again, and again and again. All to save them. Only to fail every single bloody time.

The one you can never bring yourself to kill.

mira-her-alpha-her-ruin:
He called me his ruin. Then he made me one.
Alpha Shiloh's rejection wasn’t just a scar—it was a betrayal. He left me shattered. Broken. And I had to rebuild myself in silence.
I almost forgot the way his touch once burned like salvation.
Now he’s back.
Not to beg forgiveness. To bargain. A deadly mission, he says. He promises freedom.
But then presence ignites my wolf into a frenzy. She thrashes, desperate to claim him again. But I remember the coldness in his eyes when he exiled me. The way the pack turned their backs as I crawled into the wilderness, half-dead and wholly broken. Hate simmers hotter than desire.
Yet here I am, bargaining with the devil who shattered me. Every moment we share is a lie. He doesn’t know about the shadows I’ve fed, the truth I’ve buried.
Or the child.
One whisper of its existence, and the pack will paint the forest with my blood.
But the closer we get to completing his mission, the harder it is to hide… from him, or from the part of me that still craves him.
Freedom has a price.
So does vengeance.
And I’m not sure which will destroy me first.
